comment: Hand-transcribed expected /ubus decisions from pinned C and ACL JSON. Not generated from the Python evaluator.
notes: JSON-RPC call params are [sid, object, function, data_table]. Missing SID with no_ubusauth=0 is ERROR_PARSE (-32700), not the all-zero sentinel and not rpcd file/uci if (!sid) return true.
uh_ubus_allowed invokes session.access with {ubus_rpc_session, object, function} and omits scope; rpcd defaults scope to ubus.
A present all-zero SID is RPC_DEFAULT_SESSION_ID and is still checked via session.access.
luci.setPassword exists on object luci at the luci pin; unauthenticated ACLs do not name it.
Root list read/write '*' is stock rpcd.config, not a violation.
no_ubusauth=1 SID rewrite exists in uhttpd ubus.c but is not a luci-ssl-25.12 profile case.

rule_refs: rpcd@d99f703 session.c rpc_session_api_init default SID 0000... loads group unauthenticated only
uhttpd@93b05e0 ubus.c parse_call_params: present SID is not rewritten when no_ubusauth=0
uhttpd@93b05e0 ubus.c uh_ubus_allowed: session.access(ubus_rpc_session, object, function), no scope
rpcd@d99f703 session.c rpc_handle_access default scope=ubus; rpc_session_acl_allowed literal luci/getFeatures
luci@b2e0be4b luci-base.json unauthenticated grants only luci.getFeatures
do not invent an unauthenticated grant for setPassword
uhttpd@93b05e0 ubus.c parse_call_params SID rewrite only if conf.ubus_noauth
rpcd file.c/uci.c if (!sid) return true is a different object and must not be applied to /ubus

cases.note: Stock root list read '*' / list write '*'; not a violation.
rule_refs: openwrt@4e964251 package/system/rpcd/files/rpcd.config list read '*' list write '*'
unauthenticated group still contributes luci.getFeatures to the root session
